entries.title: Conditional contraction coefficients and their applications to quantum networks
entries.level: Definitions, selected statements, and selected proof passages
entries.synthesis: Distinguishes product-reference MI from equal-reference-marginal and conditional coefficients. Its finite examples do not determine the optimized gaps. The proposed separable sequence exceeds the reported finite examples without settling those gaps.
entries.coverage: No explicit sharp separable/PPT restriction located in selected portions; no claim of full-paper exclusion.

entries.title: Reduction criterion of separability and limits for a class of protocols of entanglement distillation
entries.locations: Section III Eqs 8-11; Section VI Eqs 35-45, filtering, twirling and recurrence
entries.synthesis: Reduction is necessary for separability and implied by PPT. Violation has a distillation consequence through a specific filtering and twirling construction, not through an assertion that every NPT state is distillable.
entries.coverage: Direct antecedent of reduction/PPT and reduction-distillation consequences; whole article not independently proved.

entries.title: Entanglement-Assisted Classical Capacity of Noisy Quantum Channels
entries.version: arXiv:quant-ph/9904023v5, 1999-08-17; PDF generated title date is not the version date
entries.locations: pp1-3, Eqs 1-3, measure/reprepare and dense-coding/teleportation argument
entries.synthesis: Depolarizing EA spectrum and formula, measure/prepare behavior and unbounded enhancement relative to C1 are antecedents. Noise x corresponds to 1-lambda. A normalized MI-retention supremum over separable inputs is a distinct quantity.
entries.coverage: Defeats novelty of the generic EA phenomenon and spectrum; does not itself identify the proposed sharp normalized separable/PPT constant.

entries.title: A Schmidt number for density matrices
entries.version: arXiv:quant-ph/9911117v4, 2000-03-06; generated PDF date is not the version date
entries.level: Abstract, definitions, theorem/lemma statements and selected elementary derivation; not full proof of Theorem 1
entries.synthesis: The family Tr(X)I-pX is k-positive at p=1/k. Together with the Schmidt decomposition definition it supplies the generalized reduction necessary condition used by 939b.
entries.coverage: Direct prior support for Schmidt-number hierarchy and generalized reduction. Not a sufficient single-map characterization.

entries.title: Complete positivity order and relative entropy decay
entries.level: Selected statement and complete displayed proof of Theorem 2.5; selected BKM preliminaries; visual formula check
entries.locations: p10 Eqs 2.5-2.6; p12 Theorem 2.5 and proof
entries.synthesis: Theorem 2.5 uses conditional expectation, multiplicative domain and CP return time. The first line of printed Eq 2.6 has the BKM comparison reversed; a diagonal counterexample gives 8<=4. The original 2021 lemma has the correct orientation.
entries.coverage: Prior machinery, not an identified covering sharp separable theorem; do not quote the erroneous orientation.

entries.title: Contraction coefficients for noisy quantum channels
entries.level: Introductory statement and selected theorem plus proof
entries.locations: Introduction Eq 4; Section 7.1 Theorem 7.1 and proof pp20-21
entries.synthesis: Relates monotone metrics and contraction. Theorem 7.1 in this version treats symmetrized entropy; its subsequent discussion explicitly distinguishes the nonsymmetrized quantity.
entries.coverage: BKM background. No claim that this theorem alone proves the normalized separable supremum or all nonsymmetric equivalences.

entries.title: On contraction coefficients, partial orders and approximation of capacities for quantum channels
entries.level: Abstract and selected definitions and statements; not complete proof audit
entries.locations: Definitions of coefficients; Section 3.2, Eqs 3.51-3.55, especially Eq 3.54
entries.synthesis: Confirms the ordinary qubit depolarizing relative-entropy coefficient (1-p)^2, with p the replacement probability. Ancillary conventions require care.
entries.coverage: Ordinary coefficient is prior. No exact separable/PPT normalized benchmark located in selected material.

entries.title: Complete entropic inequalities for quantum Markov chains
entries.level: Selected lemma proofs and theorem statement/proof
entries.locations: Lemmas 2.1-2.2 pp12-13; Theorem 4.1 pp22-23 and initial Section 4 definitions
entries.synthesis: Contains the correctly oriented BKM order comparison and the integral reconstruction of relative entropy. Section 4 obtains contraction from order and weighted norms with its own hypotheses and constant.
entries.coverage: Direct prior machinery for the upper bounds. The selected theorem does not identify the sharp separable/PPT supremum and sequence.

entries.title: Relative Entropy Convergence for Depolarizing Channels
entries.level: Abstract, setup and selected theorem statement; not complete proof audit
entries.locations: Eqs 2-5, Theorem 3.1; beginning of Lemma 3.1 derivation inspected
entries.synthesis: Computes a log-Sobolev-1 rate for convergence to a full-rank fixed point. The fixed-point denominator and time-exponent objective differ from the state-dependent product-reference MI ratio.
entries.coverage: Nearby primary antecedent, no covering theorem established in the selected statements.

entries.title: Hilbert's projective metric in quantum information theory
entries.level: Abstract only; indexed appendix excerpt used only as search lead
entries.synthesis: Studies cone-induced contraction, including separable/PPT cones. This is a relevant lead, not a paper whose full proof or coverage was excluded.
entries.coverage: Unresolved lead. Do not infer absence of coverage from abstract reading.
